contract: GET /api/podcasts/:id/search-episode requires a podcast item with a feed URL (400) that the user may access (403): it requires a single string ?title (500 otherwise), fetches the feed and answers {episodes: [{episode}]} with the feed episodes ordered by fuse.js match quality against the title (title weight 0.7, subtitle 0.3, threshold 0.4); a failed feed fetch answers an empty array. The handler has no admin check, so any user who can access the item may call it; no bundled client offers it below the admin/edit UI, so that gap is not asserted.
evidence: go-backend/testmachine/scenarios/podcast_feed: the three search scenarios pass against pinned upstream in two consecutive full packet runs
exceptions: The route has no admin-only check (PodcastController.js:342-357); the only client entry point is the admin episode edit UI (client/components/modals/podcast/tabs/EpisodeMatch.vue), so the acceptance of non-admin callers is not asserted.
Match ordering depends on fuse.js scores; the scenario pins the observed order for one fixture feed instead of the score formula.

invariants.contract: An accepted search answers the feed episodes that match the title, best match first, each result an episode object with the feed title, subtitle, enclosure url/type/length, guid, duration, durationSeconds and publishedAt; a title is matched case-insensitively and without regard to diacritics, a query with no close match answers an empty array, and an unreachable feed answers an empty array.

GET /api/podcasts/:id/search-episode answers 401 without a token, 403 for an admin who cannot access the item library, 404 for an unknown item, 500 for a book item and for a missing or repeated title query parameter, and 400 for a podcast without a feed URL.
